summary: Re-tested the HeaderMenu.js pill/CTA overflow bug from iteration_40. The applied fix (adding `lg:w-auto` to the inner flex row) did NOT resolve the issue. The Get Started CTA still overflows the frosted pill's right edge by 5.8-57.8px at desktop widths 1024-1200. Mobile flows (900/768/390) and functionality (nav scroll, /auth navigation) are working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: PRIMARY BUG NOT FIXED — Get Started CTA overflows the pill's right edge at desktop widths 1024-1200. Measured overflow: 1024→+57.84px, 1050→+57.84px, 1100→+55.84px, 1150→+30.84px, 1200→+5.84px. Widths 1250/1280/1440/1920 PASS (CTA inside pill by 10-25px). Log In button stays inside at all widths (it sits further left). Pill remains horizontally centered and does not overflow the viewport (scrollWidth == innerWidth at all widths).

action_items: Root cause: the pill uses `fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 ... lg:w-auto`. For a fixed element with only `left: 50%` set (no explicit `right`), the CSS containing-block width available to `width: auto` is `100vw - 50% = 50vw`. So the pill's shrink-to-fit width is capped at ~50vw. At 1024/1100/1150/1200 the required content width (~655px) exceeds 50vw (512/550/575/600), pinning pill_w to exactly 50vw and letting inner children (specifically the right-most CTA) spill outside the visual pill boundary. Data confirms it — pill_w is exactly viewport/2 at widths 1100 (550), 1150 (575), 1200 (600), 1250 (625), 1280 (640); only ≥1440 does pill_w plateau to its true content width (~654.8).

1) Replace `fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 lg:w-auto` with `fixed inset-x-0 mx-auto w-fit lg:w-fit` (or `w-max`) so containing block is full viewport and auto-width can grow to content up to `max-w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)]`.

2) OR wrap the pill in a `fixed inset-x-0 top-4 sm:top-6 z-50 flex justify-center pointer-events-none` container and make the pill itself `pointer-events-auto inline-flex w-auto max-w-...` — this centers via flex, not translate, so `w-auto` gets the full viewport as containing block.
3) OR give the header an explicit min-width via `lg:min-w-[max-content]` combined with `lg:max-w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)]`, though (1) or (2) are cleaner.
Note: the `w-full lg:w-auto` change to the inner row is a no-op for this bug — the constraint is on the header's own containing block, not on the inner row.
critical_code_review_comments: HeaderMenu.js line 48: `fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 ... lg:w-auto` is an anti-pattern for auto-width centered fixed elements — always caps available width at 50vw. Use `inset-x-0 mx-auto w-fit` centering pattern instead.
Mobile CTA click currently uses `window.location.href = '/auth?mode=login'` which does a full page reload — consider React Router `navigate()` for consistency with SPA.
Console shows 6× 401 errors from /api/auth/me on landing page load. Harmless (user not logged in) but noisy — consider suppressing 401 log or gating the call on a token check.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The iteration_40 → iteration_41 fix (adding `lg:w-auto` on the inner row) did NOT solve the overflow. The header itself is width-capped at 50vw because of `fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2` combined with `lg:w-auto`. On re-test after the real fix, verify pill_w >= content width and cta.right <= pill.right at all widths 1024..1920. Screenshots at /app/.screenshots/pill_1100.png (visual proof: Get Started button visibly extends past the frosted pill's right rounded edge).
rca of the issue: For a `position: fixed` element whose only inset properties are `left: 50%` (via `left-1/2`) with `transform: translateX(-50%)`, the CSS `width: auto` computation uses the containing block from `left` to `right` — since `right` is unset, the browser treats the available width as `100vw - left = 50vw`. Consequently `lg:w-auto` cannot grow the pill beyond half the viewport. When rendered content needs >50vw (which happens for the desktop nav+CTAs at 1024-1200), the pill remains 50vw wide and its `justify-between` inner row (or the shrink-0 CTA container) is pushed outside the pill's visual bounds. Reproduction: open https://inflow-preview-1.preview.emergentagent.com/ at 1100px viewport → the Get Started button visibly protrudes past the frosted pill's right rounded edge (see /app/.screenshots/pill_1100.png). Mitigation: use a full-width centering wrapper (inset-x-0 flex justify-center) or `inset-x-0 mx-auto w-fit` on the pill so the containing block is 100vw and `w-auto`/`w-fit` can grow to real content width.
